description: Central Bank of Sri Lanka - Repatriation of Export proceeds into Sri Lanka Rules No. 1 of 2022
categorisation: This gazette contains rules issued by the Monetary Board of the Central Bank of Sri Lanka under the Monetary Law Act, establishing regulatory requirements for the repatriation and conversion of export proceeds. It creates new financial regulations and compliance requirements for exporters and banks, which falls under the Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5) for regulatory frameworks and statutory instruments.
